name: Clams
siboNotes: Clams are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Choose fresh or frozen over canned varieties when possible to avoid added ingredients.
preparationTips: Steam with white wine and low-FODMAP herbs like chives or parsley
Avoid garlic and onion-based preparations - use garlic-infused oil instead
Rinse canned clams thoroughly to remove excess sodium
Cook thoroughly to 145°F internal temperature for food safety
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of omega-3 fatty acids
